name: identity_group_members
description: Membership of a Person in a group; the member holds the group's grants.
lifecycle: Added and removed by owners with recent strong authentication; removed with the group or the Person, moved to the surviving Person on consolidation. Audited.

columns.Meaning: Owner (identity_persons.id) who added the member; attribution without a foreign key.
Database-clock instant the member was added.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (group_id) REFERENCES identity_groups(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (person_id) REFERENCES identity_persons(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.Purpose: A Person belongs to a group once.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX identity_group_members_person_idx ON public.identity_group_members USING btree (person_id)
constraints.Purpose: Groups of a Person when computing access.
